vex_evidence.summary: Formal safeguarding and legal notice issued by Ben Carter to Brighton Fringe trustees. Cites breaches of safeguarding, trustee duties, and activates whistleblower protection.
quoted_text: No safeguarding lead. No internal escalation. No documentation of my disclosures. Just silence — then gaslighting.

Let me remind you of the meeting where I, for the first time, admitted to staff members that I had been subjected to a year-long stalking campaign — and that just three days prior, I had taken my own life.

contradiction.title: Protected Disclosure Met With Silence, Not Procedure
contradiction.claim: Brighton Fringe followed proper safeguarding and whistleblowing protocol.
contradiction.reality: Ben Carter issued a protected legal and safeguarding notice to Brighton Fringe on 7 May 2025. The next day, the organisation retaliated by emailing his GP with defamatory claims instead of escalating the issue internally. No safeguarding or trustee record was logged.

laws.why: Processing special category data without lawful basis

timeline_patch.title: Protected Disclosure Issued to Brighton Fringe Trustees
timeline_patch.event: Ben Carter formally notifies Brighton Fringe of legal and safeguarding breaches. The email cites internal policy violations and activates whistleblower protections under UK law.
